描述_EN: more power in my pocket in 2015, this phone became a bestseller in accra, ghana. the phone comes with an led lamp attachment and three sim card slots to enable the user to access three phone numbers at the same time. the object sits in the 'housing and living' section of the design 1900-now gallery opened in june 2021. it has a long battery life and functions as a power bank for smartphones and other devices, crucial in a city and digital innovation hub where blackouts are frequent and longlasting.
描述_ZN: 2015年，在我的口袋里有更多的力量，这款手机在加纳的阿克拉成为了畅销品。 该手机配有一个LED灯附件和三个SIM卡插槽，使用户能够同时访问三个电话号码。 该物品位于2021年6月开放的设计1900-Now画廊的 "住房和生活 "部分。 它有很长的电池寿命，可以作为智能手机和其他设备的电源库，这在一个停电频繁且持续时间长的城市和数字创新中心至关重要。
